updateApplyInstructions: Run this command to start the new version:
updatePreparedDescription: The new version is in place next to the current one. Stop the current service and run it whenever you're ready.
updateCachedDescription: The new version was saved to the update cache. Development mode won't swap the program or restart it, so run it manually.
updateManualOnlyNotice: This environment can't update or restart itself. Run the prepared new version manually.

updateDownloadRequiresSse: This service can't stream download progress, so updates can't be downloaded here.

updateApplyErrorNotCompiledBinary: Not running as a packaged program, so the update can't be applied automatically.
updateApplyErrorNoPreparedUpdate: No verified update file was found. Please download it again.
updateApplyErrorNotPlaced: The update file isn't next to the current program. Please download it again.
updateApplyDescription: The new version is ready. Scheduling the update won't cut anything off: running commands and tool calls finish first, then the switch happens.
updateDrainingBackgroundBashDescription: No new background commands will start. Once these finish, remaining tool calls get their turn to wrap up.
updateQuiescingTools: Waiting for tool calls to stop safely
updateQuiescingToolsDescription: Tool calls already underway run until they can stop safely. New ones queue up and continue after the switch.
updatePausedTools: {{count}} tool call(s) queued until the new version starts.
updateResumableExecutions: {{count}} item(s) will pick back up automatically after the switch.
updatePillScheduledTooltip: The update to {{version}} is queued. Click for details.
updatePillWaitingTooltip: The update to {{version}} is waiting for running work to reach a safe stopping point. Click for details or to cancel.
updatePillRestartingTooltip: Switching to {{version}}. The page refreshes once it's up.
updatePillCancellingTooltip: Cancelling the queued update. Paused work resumes shortly.
updateWaitBlocker_tool_start_grant: A tool call awaiting approval or routing ({{seconds}}s)
updateWaitBlocker_pre_admission: A queued tool call being recorded ({{seconds}}s)
updateNoWaitDeadline: There's no deadline here — the switch waits as long as this work needs. Cancel if you'd rather update later.
updateScheduleCancelled: Update cancelled. Queued tool calls resumed, and the downloaded version is still ready whenever you want to try again.
updateRestartingDescription: Waiting for the new version to start. The page refreshes automatically once it's up.
updateZstdMissingDesc: Incremental updates require the zstd command-line tool, but it was not found on this system. Please install zstd and try again.
updateZstdMissingDescWindows: Incremental updates require the zstd command-line tool, which is downloaded automatically from the update server. The download failed this time (usually a network timeout). Please check your connection and retry.
updateZstdInstallCmd:
# macOS
brew install zstd

# Debian / Ubuntu
sudo apt install zstd

# Fedora / RHEL
sudo dnf install zstd
